answer: Agents keep a heartbeat in an atlas: one compute proof per epoch, backed by $20. A random beacon spot-checks 5% each epoch; a picked agent must answer in ten minutes or lose the deposit. 1,000 fakes cost $500 daily in compute plus $20,000 locked, yet each earns $0.10 per epoch, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once; like an orchard, reputation grown slowly cannot be faked overnight, and at each summit peers prune dead branches.
